description: Send a signed monitor.test event with one sample item to the monitor's webhook and report what the endpoint answered: { delivered (a 2xx within 10 seconds), status_code, error, duration_ms }. Free; it is not retried, does not count toward webhook_failing, and does not change webhook.last_delivery. 400 when the monitor has no webhook.

monitor_id.description: monitor_id returned by monitor-create or monitor-list, example: '6f1d0c9e-0d55-4b8e-9a3c-3c4d9b8e2a10'.

name: monitor-webhook-test
title: Test Monitor Webhook
